full.description: Interactive Weight-Space Programming workbench with all WSP tools and skills enabled (no built-in bash/edit/write).

tool-free.description: Strict zero-tool harness (Experiments 1, 2, 4, 5). Disables all tools, uses neutral 1-line instructions, and audits tool_free=true.

sandbox.description: Sandboxed Python & forward-pass harness (Experiments 3, 6). No shell/file tools; only WSP sandbox, model download, and budgeted passes.

surgical-edit.description: Targeted weight-editing harness (Experiments 4, 8). Enforces EXPLAIN EVERY STEP, protected tensor guards, and diff manifests.

weight-only.description: Strict weight-only audit: inspect/edit/sandbox only; no forward pass, no HF download, no bash. Pair with WSP_WEIGHT_ONLY=1 AST+path guards.
